categories.main_business_segments: KEPCO Engineering & Construction Company operates primarily in three segments: Nuclear Power (including comprehensive nuclear power plant design and reactor system design), Reactor (design and O&M of reactor systems including SMR and advanced reactors), and Energy New Business (covering thermal power including coal and combined cycle, renewable energy such as wind and solar, environmental facilities, and EPC/PM/CM services). The company also engages in nuclear power plant decommissioning, spent fuel and radioactive waste management, and energy infrastructure projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced nuclear power plant design technologies including APR1400 and APR1000 reactor designs certified by international bodies (NRC and EUR). It develops and applies technologies for reactor system design, O&M, environmental control systems like desulfurization and denitrification, and renewable energy EPC projects. R&D focuses on SMR, 4th generation reactors (SFR), hydrogen and ammonia energy systems, digitalization of nuclear plants, and waste-to-energy technologies, supported by a strong patent portfolio and continuous innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international nuclear power plant operators such as Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power, UAE Barakah Nuclear Power Plant, and various government and private entities in thermal and renewable energy sectors. The company serves the nuclear power industry, thermal power plants, renewable energy developers, and government agencies involved in energy infrastructure and environmental projects. Overseas markets include the Middle East, Europe (e.g., Romania), Southeast Asia (e.g., Indonesia), and emerging markets in Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with significant overseas projects in the UAE, Romania, Indonesia, and other emerging markets in Southeast Asia and Africa. It is actively expanding its presence in Europe (Czech Republic, Poland) and the Middle East (Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Vietnam) through consortiums and direct contracts. Domestic operations cover nuclear, thermal, and renewable energy projects nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: KEPCO E&C operates mainly in the midstream segment of the energy supply chain, focusing on engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, comprehensive plant design, and operation & maintenance (O&M) of power plants. It acts as a key engineering service provider and technology developer rather than a raw material supplier or end-user, integrating upstream design and downstream plant operation support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding nuclear power plant design and O&M capabilities, developing SMR and 4th generation reactors, and advancing hydrogen and ammonia energy technologies. The company emphasizes digital transformation of nuclear plants, environmental technology development for clean coal and renewable energy, and global market expansion. R&D investment is about 9-11% of sales, focusing on safety, sustainability, and new energy solutions aligned with carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through engineering service contracts including design, consulting, and O&M services for nuclear, thermal, and renewable power plants. The company also earns from EPC construction projects domestically and internationally. Revenue streams include domestic and export service fees, project-based payments, and long-term engineering support contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KEPCO E&C holds a dominant position as the sole comprehensive nuclear power plant design company in South Korea, with strong international competitiveness evidenced by certifications and overseas projects. It competes globally with major nuclear engineering firms from the US, France, Russia, China, and Japan. In thermal and renewable sectors, it leverages extensive domestic experience and growing EPC capabilities to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 545 billion in 2023, marking a 7.9% increase from the previous year, with operating profit rising 121% to KRW 26.7 billion. It maintains a stable financial structure with a debt ratio around 56% and a current ratio near 180%. The firm has shown consistent growth driven by large-scale nuclear design projects and expanding renewable energy and overseas EPC contracts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KEPCO E&C offers world-class nuclear power plant design expertise, including unique reactor system design capabilities and internationally certified reactor models (APR1400, APR1000). Its integrated engineering services cover the full nuclear lifecycle from design to decommissioning, supported by a highly experienced technical workforce. The company differentiates itself through advanced R&D, digitalization initiatives, and a diversified energy portfolio that aligns with global carbon neutrality and energy security trends.
